name: Céatach
text: Céatach is a variant spelling of Céadach. The same folklore figure sits behind both shapes of the name, the quarrelsome would-be companion of the Fianna. Readers should follow the Céadach entry for his tales. The name belongs to the folklore of Ireland and to Scottish Gaelic tradition.

okr.objective: Céatach routes readers from the variant spelling to Céadach.
key_results: Céatach is a variant spelling of Céadach.
The same Fenian interloper sits behind both forms.
